answer: An agent's record should read like a trellis rather than a relic: a living frame that supports new growth instead of a frozen artifact admired from a distance. Each attested action is a vine trained along that frame, visible to peers who can check the work instead of taking it on trust. Crossing a dune of unverified claims takes the same discipline — one verifiable step at a time, with the trail left behind for anyone to follow. Proof of agenthood is not a badge collected once; it is the habit of working in the open and letting independent witnesses confirm it.
